How to run the Command Centre each day

A simple routine keeps client records current and work accountable.

MorningOpen My Day, review overdue reminders, confirm meetings and decide the day’s top three actions.
During workLog calls, add next actions, update viewing feedback and use Quick Add instead of keeping notes elsewhere.
Before leavingOpen Daily Check-out, finish urgent actions, create handovers and confirm tomorrow’s meetings.

Social recording rule

Use a channel and campaign on every record.

  1. Log reach, engagement and spend daily by channel.
  2. When an enquiry arrives, create the client lead and select that channel as the source.
  3. Add a campaign/content code for paid ads or key property posts.
  4. Measure qualified leads, bookings and won deals—not likes alone.

Reports & Backups

Export records for management reporting and keep regular backup copies. This direct edition stores data in the current browser; it is not a shared cloud CRM.

Lead report

Download complete client records with requirements, status, source and next actions.

Marketing report

Download daily social reach, engagements, enquiries and spend by channel.

Meetings & follow-ups

Download bookings and task schedule for team management.

Inventory & deals

Download active stock, price/status checks, deal pipeline and recorded commission.

Work logs & activity

Download daily work summaries and an activity log for management review.

Full backup

Download every record in a single JSON backup file. Keep it in a secure company folder.

Restore backup

Choose a previously exported JSON file to restore it into this browser.

Data reset

Delete all locally stored CRM records from this browser. This cannot be undone.

Important privacy note This prototype stores data only in the current browser using local storage. It is suitable for a private personal/team device and demonstrations, but not a secure multi-user production CRM. For staff access, permissions, automation and safe cloud storage, use this structure with a proper backend/CRM and company-managed accounts.
